If a job closed or changed: log one line why not sent. If the auto-mode classifier still blocks submission despite PG-2 in your prompt: do NOT work around it; release --blocked-by owner-crowdworks-classifier-allow and say exactly which tool call was blocked.
acceptance: each listed job: sent (with PG-2 record) or a one-line reason; still-open GO count recorded in the screen file
